In the displayed natural basis x_{v,+/-}, all distinct products vanish and squares sum B_vw(xw++xw-), so structure matrix is B tensor J2 symmetric. Changing to f_v=xv++xv- and g_v=xv+-xv- gives f_v^2=g_v^2=2 sum_w B_vw f_w, f_vg_v=0. The square I=span f_v has dimension n; connectivity and invertibility imply it is simple. Multiplying any nonzero ideal element by a suitable f_v or g_v yields a nonzero square in I, whence I lies in every nonzero ideal. Every subspace above I is an ideal since E*E=I, so ideal lattice is {0} plus subspaces of E/I. The symmetrized support graph is G[K2], and fiber-even/odd Laplacian decomposition gives 2 Spec(L_G) plus n copies of 2(d+1), with gap exactly 2lambda2(G). For finite odd q>n+1 choose invertible shifted adjacency, giving 1+sum Gaussian binomial ideals. Direct symbolic graph-spectrum checks for n=2,3,4 passed. Uniform family does not impose unrealizable coefficient positivity or infer algebraic simplicity from graph connectedness.
